verdicts.reason: A breaks the design. The small quote-mark glyphs are blown up into huge dark blocks that dominate the right side and fight the headline. The white frame over the photo has turned into an empty white rectangle floating in the middle, and the headline is oversized and jammed against the top and the left glyph. B keeps the original intact but is just the original letterboxed into the taller canvas, with large dead bands above and below. Nothing was rearranged for the new shape, and the small quote text and author box now look undersized and stranded.
